about.title: Unsecured Loan Calculator - Personal Loan Payment, APR & Total Cost Estimator
about.description: The Unsecured Loan Calculator estimates monthly payments, total interest, and overall borrowing cost for personal loans that do not require collateral. Compare APRs, terms, and fees, and review how credit profile and debt-to-income (DTI) may affect affordability and lender evaluation.

howTo.title: How to Use the Unsecured Loan Calculator

steps.title: Enter Loan Amount
steps.description: Input the principal you want to borrow for debt consolidation, emergencies, or major purchases.

steps.title: Select APR & Term
steps.description: Choose the annual percentage rate and repayment term (e.g., 24–60 months).

steps.title: Add Fees
steps.description: Include origination or underwriting fees to estimate true cost.

steps.title: Review Monthly Payment
steps.description: See amortized payments and interest across the schedule.

steps.title: Compare Scenarios
steps.description: Adjust APR, term, or amount to find a comfortable payment and lower total interest.

tips: Higher credit scores generally qualify for lower APRs.
Shorter terms increase payment but save on total interest.
Prequalify with a soft credit check to compare offers without impacting score.

features.title: Payment & Interest Breakdown
features.description: Amortization schedule shows principal and interest over time.

features.title: Fee-Adjusted APR
features.description: Model origination fees to reflect overall borrowing cost more clearly.

features.title: DTI Awareness
features.description: Estimate how the new payment affects your debt-to-income ratio.

features.title: Offer Comparison
features.description: Test multiple APR and term combinations to compare payment and cost tradeoffs.

faq.a: A personal loan that does not require collateral; approval is based on creditworthiness, income, and DTI.

faq.q: How can I compare unsecured loan offers?
faq.a: Compare APR, fees, repayment term, monthly payment, and lender requirements together rather than focusing on one number alone.
Many personal loans have no prepayment penalty; review your contract before making extra payments.
Unsecured loans avoid collateral risk but may have higher APRs; secured loans can be cheaper but put assets at risk.

faq.q: Will applying hurt my credit score?
faq.a: Rate checks with prequalification are usually soft pulls; a formal application often triggers a hard inquiry that may temporarily lower your score.
